# iru_blueprint_routing (Resource)

Manages the existing tenant-wide Blueprint routing enrollment settings. Apply uses PATCH; destroy releases Terraform management without changing Iru because no DELETE is documented. Does not manage routing rules or Assignment Map conditions. Import using tenant.

Declare this singleton once per tenant. Both enrollment settings are explicit:
there is no activation default. Import is read-only, and adopting matching
settings during apply also makes no write. A changed setting uses the documented
PATCH operation. The code is sensitive in displays but remains in state.

Destroy releases the Terraform state entry while retaining the tenant settings.
The API documents GET/PATCH only; the provider sends no DELETE, does not rotate
or disable the code during destroy, and does not pretend to create a new routing
object. A 404 or permission failure during refresh retains state and reports an
error rather than treating this singleton as a deleted object.

Routing rules and Assignment Map node logic are outside this endpoint's contract.
Live updates affect tenant-wide manual enrollment and require an appropriate test
tenant or an explicitly reviewed change. Mock lifecycle tests do not establish
live compatibility.

## Example Usage


```terraform
# Match the tenant's existing settings before adopting management.
resource "iru_blueprint_routing" "example" {
  enrollment_code   = "123456"
  enrollment_active = false
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enrollment_active` (Boolean) Explicit manual enrollment activation setting. Match the existing setting when importing.
- `enrollment_code` (String, Sensitive) Manual enrollment code. Stored in Terraform state despite display redaction.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Logical singleton identifier: tenant. Iru supplies no remote UUID for these settings.

## Import

Use the logical singleton identifier `tenant`; Iru supplies no remote UUID.
Match the current code and activation setting for a no-change import plan.


```shell
terraform import iru_blueprint_routing.example tenant
```


Contract: [official Iru Blueprint Routing API](https://api-docs.iru.com/).
